title: freeze
caption: freeze lists every change in the window, applies the registered selector, and writes a signed, time-stamped manifest. The default branch's head is checked against GitHub's push log.
alt: Terminal output of pr-rla freeze: 889 changes landed, N = 171 selected, four timestamps proven
